title: Sol-Attn project page and implementation branch referenced
summary: On 2026-08-03, a message in the sana thread linked the Sol-Attn project page and the NVlabs/Sana `sol-engine` branch. Together, those references mark a publicly documented development step for the Sol-Attn project that should be reviewed for inclusion in its history. The available evidence does not establish whether the date was an announcement, release, or code update.
